# crosswork_demand_matrix_domain (Data Source)

This data source can read the demand matrix state of one domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_demand_matrix_domain" "example" {
  id = "32"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `domain_id` (String) Domain identifier
- `enable` (Boolean) Enables the demand matrix of the domain
